description: 斯拉夫防御 D10 — 反例：c线开放后车放错位，黑方Rc8抢占c线

intro.popup_en: Line Control, Lesson 4: A cautionary example. The c-file opens, but White places the rook on the wrong file. Watch the mistake with Rab1.
intro.popup:
线路控制第4课
这是一个反例！
c线打开后，车放错了位置
请注意白方Rab1的错误

outro.popup_en: Rab1 points the rook toward the b-file even though the c-file is open. Black takes the c-file first with ...Rc8. White can later play Rfc1, but has lost a tempo and surrendered the initiative. The direction of the rook matters.
outro.popup:
反例总结
Rab1错在方向——c线开放却走了b线
黑方Rc8率先占领c线
白方虽能Rfc1补上
但有失先的嫌疑，意义大不同

moves.popup_en: d4 begins a Queen's Pawn opening and the Queen's Gambit structure.
moves.popup:
d4开局
后翼兵型序列开始

moves.popup_en: ...d5 mirrors White's central occupation and keeps the position solid.
moves.popup:
d5对称
黑方稳健

moves.popup_en: c4! The Queen's Gambit challenges d5. The c-file may become the key battleground, so watch when it opens.
moves.popup:
c4！后翼弃兵
c4-c5线将成为关键战场
注意c线的开放时机

moves.popup_en: ...c6 begins the Slav Defense. Black supports d5 while keeping the c8-bishop's diagonal open.
moves.popup:
c6斯拉夫防御
黑方不走e6
保留发展黑格象的空间

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops, supports c4, and prepares to contest the center.
moves.popup:
Nc3发展
支持c4，准备中心对抗

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops a minor piece.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展
黑方轻子出动

moves.popup_en: cxd5! White exchanges, making the c-file semi-open. White should already be considering Rc1 to occupy it.
moves.popup:
cxd5兑换！
c线立刻成为半开放线
此时白方应该预判：
Rc1会是最好的布车

moves.popup_en: ...cxd5 recaptures. The c-file is open; White must now choose where to place a rook.
moves.popup:
cxd5黑方重提
c线已开放！
白方下一步如何布车？

moves.popup_en: Bf4 develops the bishop and controls e5 while White continues the opening setup.
moves.popup:
Bf4发展象
控制e5
开局发展继续

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops Black's knight.
moves.popup:
Nc6出马
黑方发展

moves.popup_en: e3 stabilizes the center and supports White's development.
moves.popup:
e3稳固中心
白方巩固发展

moves.popup_en: ...Bf5 develops the bishop along a characteristic Slav diagonal from c8 toward h3.
moves.popup:
Bf5黑格象出动
斯拉夫特征：黑格象在c8-h3线上

moves.popup_en: Bd3! White challenges Black's bishop and prepares to exchange it, simplifying the position.
moves.popup:
Bd3！白方象挑战黑格象
准备兑换Bxd3或互换
简化局面

moves.popup_en: ...Bxd3 exchanges the bishops and resolves the contest between them.
moves.popup:
黑方Bxd3兑换
消除了黑格象之争

moves.popup_en: Qxd3 recaptures. White's queen becomes active, but the c-file has been open for several moves and rook placement is now critical.
moves.popup:
Qxd3重提
皇后站d3，攻势初显
此时c线已开，白方的布车选择至关重要！

moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces Black's center.
moves.popup:
e6稳健
黑方巩固中心

moves.popup_en: Nf3 completes White's minor-piece development.
moves.popup:
Nf3发展
白方轻子全部出动

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops and prepares Black to castle.
moves.popup:
Be7发展
准备王车易位

moves.popup_en: White castles. The rook on f1 is ready to become active.
moves.popup:
白方王车易位
f1车准备参战

moves.popup_en: Black also castles. Development is complete and White faces the key decision about the open file.
moves.popup:
黑方也王车易位
开局发展完毕
关键决策时刻到来

moves.popup_en: Rab1?! This is the mistake. The c-file is open, but White moves the a1-rook to b1, a file with no clear purpose. White should play Rac1 to contest the c-file; the correct route is indicated on the board.
moves.popup:
Rab1！这是错误！
c线已经开放，白方应该Rac1
但这里把a1车走到了b1
→ b线没有打开，b1车没有价值
→ c线控制权拱手相让
绿色箭头：正确应走Rac1

moves.popup_en: ...Rc8! Black immediately occupies the c-file. White has wasted a move with Rab1, and Black gets there first. Had White played Rac1, Black would not have gained this tempo.
moves.popup:
Rc8！黑方立刻抢占c线！
白方Rab1浪费了一步
黑车率先进驻c8
白方想控制c线——已经晚了！
如果白方走的是Rac1，就不会有这个问题

moves.popup_en: Rfc1 tries to repair the mistake and finally contests the c-file. But Black's rook is already on c8, so White is reacting rather than taking the initiative. Losing one tempo changes who controls the file.
moves.popup:
Rfc1——亚羊补牢
白方终于把车搬到c线
但黑方Rc8已在c8，先手在黑
双车共争c线——白方被动应对
失先一步就是失了主动权
